versions.content: The LIN Interface shall execute a schedule table of the type RUN_ONCE from the first entry to the last entry before changing to a new schedule table. But, if a collision occurs in an event-triggered frame response, the LIN Interface shall switch to a collision resolving schedule table according to SWS_LinIf_00176.
